title: Advanced Shutdown
description: With this plugin you can turn on the server on a timer
body:
📌 🛠 AdvancedShutdown (Restart)
AdvancedShutdown is a lightweight and powerful plugin for Minecraft server administrators that allows for organized shutdowns or restarts. Instead of an abrupt kick, it provides a beautiful visual countdown and alerts for all players.

✏️ ✨ Key Features:
• Dynamic BossBar: Players see a shrinking progress bar at the top of their screen with a real-time countdown.
• Smart Time Formatting: The plugin automatically formats time for better readability (e.g., "1 min. 30 sec." or just "15 sec.").
• Multi-language Support (EN/RU): Built-in support for English and Russian, easily toggled in the configuration file.
• Final Countdown Effects: During the last 5 seconds, players receive dramatic on-screen Titles and audible pings to ensure they don't miss the warning.
• Fully Customizable: Tailor everything to your server's style — prefixes, BossBar colors, styles, sounds, and messages.
• Global Notifications: Announcements about starting or cancelling the timer are broadcasted to all players.

---

✏️ 💻 Commands & Permissions:
| Command | Description | Permission |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| /stopserver [sec] | Starts the countdown (Default: 60s) | shutdown.admin |
| /stopcancel | Cancels the scheduled restart/shutdown | shutdown.admin |
